title: GET /api/v1/feed/turn success
description: The whole turn a feed entry finished, in order: from the user's message that started it (the chat's last `user` message at or before the entry's position) to the entry's position, or with `after` the messages past that position. `more` says the turn continues past the last one returned (ask again with its position as `after`). No messages when the machine didn't upload the chat.
